chapter: Tiny Bradshaw, Teddy Hill and Europe
title: Wrapping up Teddy Hill; clarifying Willie Bryant and the move to Kirby
summary: He never worked steadily with Willie Bryant, went straight from Hill to John Kirby, and they continue for fifteen minutes before his wife arrives.
